## [1.4.0](https://github.com/zipzopzippy/gboard-morphe-patch/compare/v1.3.1...v1.4.0) (2026-11-26)

### ✨ New Features

* Replace Enable Scan text with a generic Enable feature flags patch ([f238cd2](https://github.com/zipzopzippy/gboard-morphe-patch/commit/f238cd2d6a7e166cdbf8aec58125dbd43f0728c5))

patches.name: Enable feature flags
patches.description: Switches on Gboard features that are off by default and normally enabled remotely by Google, which the network guard prevents. By default: Scan text and inline autofill suggestions (password manager suggestions in the suggestion strip).

options.description: Names of Gboard boolean flags whose default is set to true.

patches.name: Network guard
patches.description: Blocks all network requests from Gboard except for hosts in an allowlist. Adds a 'Network access' screen to Gboard settings to edit the allowlist and view a request log. Emoji Kitchen, language packs, translation and offline voice packs are allowed by default.

options.description: Rules allowed out of the box (editable later inside Gboard settings). Each rule is a host ('example.com'), a wildcard host ('*.example.com'), or a host with a path prefix ('example.com/some/path/').
Play services actions Gboard may still connect to when Play services hand-offs are blocked. A trailing * matches a prefix.
Also refuse Gboard's connections to Google Play services (logging, config sync, ...), except for actions allowed in Gboard settings. Play services' own traffic is not affected.
If disabled, the guard starts switched off until enabled in Gboard settings.

patches.name: Offline voice typing
patches.description: Lets Gboard's on-device speech recognizer work for all languages it has speech packs for (not just English (US)), and prefers it over Google's online recognizer. Can be switched in Gboard settings > Network access.

options.description: Skip Google's online speech recognizer by default (changeable later in Gboard settings).

patches_name: Network Guard for Gboard by zipzopzippy
